originalTitle: U.S. stock futures flat after soaring yields, AI jitters dent Wall St
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures steadied on Monday evening after soaring yields and concerns over slowing artificial intelligence development dented Wall Street.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures steadied on Monday evening after soaring yields and concerns over slowing artificial intelligence development dented Wall Street.

Anticipation of a raft of key economic prints and Federal Reserve commentary also spurred caution towards U.S. markets, especially amid growing anxiety over higher interest rates.

S&P 500 Futures fell 0.08% to 7,740.25 points by 20:19 ET (00:19 GMT). Dow Jones Futures fell 0.08% to 51,796.0 points, while Nasdaq 100 Futures fell 0.05% to 30,548.0 points.

Concerns over Iran also weighed, after U.S. President Donald Trump denied a report that he had offered any concessions to Iran for a nuclear deal.

Goldman Sachs Group Inc (NYSE:GS) was in focus after the Wall Street Journal reported the bank's board discussed a plan for CEO David Solomon to step down and be replaced by operating officer John Waldron by as soon as 2027.

AI trade under pressure as OpenAI halts model training

OpenAI was a major source of pressure on Wall Street after reports said the AI startup had halted training of new models and had also scrapped plans to release a new model in the coming days.

The reports battered the chipmaking and data center complex, as markets feared a broader slowdown in AI development, which could in turn erode demand for chips and compute capacity.

Adding to pressure on technology stocks, Treasury yields remained upbeat this week after racing to multi-year highs earlier in the month. The benchmark 10-year rate remained pinned above 5.2% and close to levels last seen in 2007.

Focus this week is on key labor market readings and Fed commentary for more cues on the path of rates. JOLTS job openings data for August is due later on Tuesday, while Fed officials including Michelle Bowman, Austan Goolsbee, and John Williams are set to speak on Tuesday.

The Fed hiked rates by 25 basis points earlier in September and presented a hawkish outlook in the face of sticky inflation. Any signs of labor market strength give the Fed more headroom to raise rates.

Tech stocks lagged on Monday, with the NASDAQ Composite down 0.9%. The S&P 500 fell 0.77% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.67%.

Iran tensions persist after Trump denies offering relief

Concerns over the Iran war also remained in play after U.S. President Donald Trump denied an Axios report that he was willing to grant Tehran some sanctions relief in exchange for assurances on its nuclear program.

The report came as Qatari and Pakistani mediators continued to work towards hashing out a peace deal between the warring countries, although there appeared to be few signs of progress.

The U.S. and Iran remained at odds over the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran seen attacking ships in the waterway, while the U.S. maintained its naval blockade against the country.

Trump over the weekend said he had rejected Iran's most recent offer for peace. Separately, Iranian officials said they were hopeful for a peace deal in the coming days.

chineseTitle: 收益率飙升后美国股指期货持平，AI 恐慌削弱了华尔街

chineseContent:

对一系列重要经济数据和美联储评论的预期也促使人们对美国市场持谨慎态度，尤其是在人们对利率上升的焦虑日益加剧的情况下。

截至美国东部时间 20:19（格林威治标准时间 00:19），标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.08% 至 7,740.25 点。道琼斯期货下跌0.08%至51,796.0点，纳斯达克100期货下跌0.05%至30,548.0点。

在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普否认有关他曾就核协议向伊朗做出任何让步的报道后，对伊朗的担忧也随之而来。

据《华尔街日报》报道，高盛集团 (NYSE:GS) 董事会讨论了首席执行官大卫·所罗门 (David Solomon) 辞职并最快在 2027 年由运营官约翰·沃尔德伦 (John Waldron) 接替的计划，该公司成为焦点。

OpenAI 停止模型训练，人工智能贸易面临压力

有报道称，OpenAI 已停止新模型的训练，并取消了在未来几天发布新模型的计划，这成为华尔街面临的主要压力来源。

这些报告重创了芯片制造和数据中心综合体，因为市场担心人工智能发展会出现更广泛的放缓，这反过来可能会削弱对芯片和计算能力的需求。

美国国债收益率在本月早些时候飙升至多年高点后，本周仍保持乐观，这加大了科技股的压力。基准 10 年期利率仍维持在 5.2% 以上，接近 2007 年的水平。

本周的焦点是关键的劳动力市场数据和美联储的评论，以获取有关利率走势的更多线索。 8 月份的 JOLTS 职位空缺数据将于周二晚些时候公布，而包括米歇尔·鲍曼 (Michelle Bowman)、奥斯坦·古尔斯比 (Austan Goolsbee) 和约翰·威廉姆斯 (John Williams) 在内的美联储官员将于周二发表讲话。

9月初，美联储加息25个基点，并在通胀高企的情况下呈现出鹰派的前景。劳动力市场走强的任何迹象都会给美联储带来更多加息空间。

科技股周一表现落后，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 0.9%。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.77%，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 0.67%。

特朗普否认提供救济后，伊朗紧张局势持续存在

在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普否认 Axios 的报道后，对伊朗战争的担忧也依然存在。 Axios 的报道称，他愿意给予德黑兰一些制裁减免，以换取对其核计划的保证。

该报告发布之际，卡塔尔和巴基斯坦调解人仍在努力敲定交战国家之间的和平协议，尽管似乎没有取得进展的迹象。

美国和伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡问题上仍存在分歧，德黑兰袭击了该水道上的船只，而美国则维持对该国的海上封锁。

特朗普周末表示，他拒绝了伊朗最近提出的和平提议。另外，伊朗官员表示，他们对未来几天达成和平协议抱有希望。
